title: Moots Updates Its Routt Gravel Bike for Big Tires and New Geo
content:
The new version of the classic American titanium gravel bike comes with 57mm of tire clearance, long chainstays, and a premium price tag.

Read the full article at Moots Updates Its Routt Gravel Bike for Big Tires and New Geo on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
